plan.notes: B.S. Computer Science (Systems variant), College of Engineering and Polymer Science. Built from the official University of Akron Undergraduate Bulletin 'Recommended Sequence' (https://bulletin.uakron.edu/undergraduate/colleges-programs/engineering-polymer-science/computer-science/computer-science-systems-bscs/computer-science-systems-bscs.pdf). Requirements summary: General Education 24 (several major courses double-count toward the 36-credit Gen Ed), Preadmission Major Core 16 (MATH 208, CPSC 209, CPSC 210, MATH 221), Mathematics and Statistics 8, Natural Science 8, Computer Science Core 27, Technical Electives 15, additional 22 credits to reach 120. Technical electives must include a minimum of 9 credits of 300/400-level CPSC coursework plus 6 additional credits of approved 300/400-level electives (CPSC 406 excluded); modeled as generic choice slots. Natural Science: 8 credits from BIOL 111, CHEM 151/152, GEOL 101, PHYS 261 or 291. CPSC 490 also satisfies the General Education Capstone requirement; MATH 221 satisfies the Mathematics, Statistics and Logic requirement. Uses Akron's new course numbering (CPSC/MATH prefixes). A 2.0 GPA is required in all major coursework.
